en.title: Amazon OA #332: Reduce Memory Usage
en.description: A data center has N processes, and processes[i] is the memory used by process i. You must delete exactly m processes at consecutive positions from the list so that the total memory used by the remaining processes is as small as possible. Output this minimum total.
en.input: The first line contains two integers N and m. The second line contains N integers processes[0..N-1], separated by whitespace. 2≤N≤3×10^6, 2≤m≤99999 and m≤N, 2≤processes[i]≤999999999.
en.output: Output one integer: the minimum total remaining memory after deleting a contiguous segment of m processes. The answer may exceed the 32-bit integer range.
en.explanation: Example 1: delete 13 and 20, leaving 10+4+8=22. Example 2: delete a contiguous segment of length 3 from [5,9,2,7]; deleting 5,9,2 leaves 7 and deleting 9,2,7 leaves 5, so the answer is 5. Example 3: when N=m=2, everything must be deleted, leaving 0.
hints: The remaining total equals the overall total minus the sum of the deleted segment.
The larger the sum of the deleted segment, the better.
Use a sliding window to find the maximum sum over all windows of length m, and use 64-bit integers.
